request.palette_name: Dungeon Matcher forest bark, moss and cool stone
request.description: One separate lower LEFT corner environmental root-and-rock cluster sprite for an enchanted forest mobile game UI. Not a scene or frame. Tall asymmetric L-shaped ancient tree ROOT BUTTRESS: a thick twisting exposed-bark trunk rises along the LEFT edge, while a heavy root curls diagonally across the LOWER quarter toward the right. Keep the UPPER RIGHT TWO THIRDS mostly transparent negative space so a button can sit there. Two large embedded cool gray-blue angular boulders anchor the LOWER LEFT root foot, moss grows only on upward planes; a red toadstool and two small pale mushrooms grow from the lowest root joints, a tiny violet-white flower tuft, a couple of short vine ends and very sparse leaves. Hierarchy: strong warm brown woody root mass first, broad stone planes second, moss third, small mushrooms/flowers last. Exposed wood dominates over foliage. Chunky crisp native pixel art, dark restrained outlines, simple top-left lighting, broad connected clusters, no noise, no gradients, no dithering. Visible long bark ridges, organic root hollows, natural asymmetry. Entire self-contained silhouette inside the 96x128 canvas with at least 6 transparent pixels around EVERY edge including base and tall root tip. End in complete rounded/tapered forms; no chopped rectangular ends. No floor plane, background, panel, frame border, UI, text, character, wisps or magical glow. Use supplied composition crop only for grounded root/stone/mushroom relationships, not its UI.

reference_images.usage: Lower-left root and stone composition, naturally clustered mushrooms and small flowers. Ignore all UI and background; one separate L-shaped side prop only.
